name: voting
description: Club elections: voter eligibility, one-time tokens, ranked ballots counted by instant runoff, quorum rules, a hash-chained audit log and result export.
author: test3 author (Claude subagent)

issues.description: The docstring says the quorum is rounded up to a whole ballot, but int() truncates, so a third of 10 members gives a quorum of 3 instead of 4.
issues.fix_hint: Round the product up (math.ceil, or ceiling division on the fraction).

issues.description: The tally is created once before the round loop and never reset, so each round's votes are added to the previous rounds' totals; the documented 'counted afresh' rule is broken and a first-round leader can win a round they should lose.
issues.fix_hint: Start a new tally for the remaining candidates at the top of each round.

issues.anchor: elif any(name not in self.candidates for name in ranking):
issues.description: The docstring requires each candidate to appear at most once in a ranking, but cast only checks for an empty ranking and unknown names, so a ballot ranking the same candidate twice is accepted.
issues.fix_hint: Reject the ballot when len(set(ranking)) != len(ranking).

issues.description: Voting tokens, the only credential for casting a ballot, come from the random module's Mersenne Twister, which is predictable from its seed or earlier outputs, so tokens can be guessed and ballots cast in other members' names.
issues.fix_hint: Generate tokens with the secrets module or random.SystemRandom.

issues.description: The eligibility rule (dues paid, not suspended, member for the minimum number of days) is implemented again inside the ballot box instead of calling Roll.is_eligible, so the two copies can drift apart.

issues.anchor: def suspicious_activity(entries: list[AuditEntry], max_rejections: int) -> list[str]:
issues.description: suspicious_activity handles three unrelated checks in one loop nested five levels deep (for, elif, if, if/else, if), which makes it hard to read and extend.

decoys.why_it_is_fine: The file name comes from slugify, which keeps only lower-case letters, digits and dashes, so an election name with ../ or slashes cannot leave the results folder.
2 * votes > counted is the integer form of 'more than half'; exactly half is correctly not a majority.
